This will not stand. I will see that horrendous thing destroyed.

I will be free."

Alad V

It may manifest into three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra which their bizarre master must travel.

General.Name: Gruzzling

General.Name: Techrot Galliflex

General.Name: Techrot Skuzzi

General.Name: Techrot Matmas

General.Name: Techrot Miasmite

General.Description: This heavily armored, slow moving unit lays down the law with dual Efervon cannons.
General.Name: Scaldra Dedicant

General.Description: Specialized Scaldra demoltions unit, with an impressive vocal range.
General.Name: Scaldra Screamer

General.Description: Quick and lethal. This Scaldra unit has been trained to rush the target and inflict maximum damage with their curved blades.
General.Name: Scaldra Flayer

General.Description: This armored personnel carrier is designed to move Scaldra forces quickly and easily around Höllvania. Its roof mounted turret provides lethal defense.
General.Name: Scaldra TI-92

General.Description: This automated aerial unit tracks and triangulates its target with lasers and then fires a high caliber rifle shot.
General.Name: Scaldra Harbinger

General.Description: Sporting a ballistic shield, this heavy unit closes the distance while laying down pistol fire. Carries an Efervon gel cannon.
General.Name: Scaldra Barbican

General.Description: This support unit smokes out its target with gas grenades and finishes the job with blows from his massive club.
General.Name: Scaldra Eradicator

General.Description: This rifle unit has been trained to suppress the enemy with volley after volley of machine gun fire.
General.Name: Scaldra Jaeger

General.Description: A cloned soldier in top fighting form. Lancers formed the front line of the Orokin legions, advancing relentlessly to carry the full might of the army deep into enemy territory. Lancers were chosen for sheer-minded determination, the ones who found it hard to let go of an idea.
General.Name: Anarch Grineer Lancer

General.Description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch dfaction. With shield above and staff in hand, Dax medics are as adept at healing as their brethren are at cutting down the opposition.
General.Name: Anarch Capsarii

General.Description: Only the most cunning of clone stock are chosen to become trappers. These are given training in the operation of Trapper Drones by Archimedea; many do not make it through the training. Trappers are frequently ostracized from their squads due to mishaps while they are learning to aim.
General.Name: Anarch Grineer Trapper

General.Description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. It was not uncommon to witness Dax rangers supporting Tenno as they first leanrt to control their Warframes, filling in offensive gaps with precise aim.
General.Name: Anarch Arcus

General.Description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Across many operations, the thunderous salvo of a Libritor Archgun served as a signal for hidden Dax forced to emerge from the shadows and fall upon their enemies like a guillotine's blade.
General.Name: Anarch Libritor

General.Description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. While their ability and disappearing techniques allowed these Dax to quell revolts before they had formed in earnest, their experiences allowed for their own rebellion to to flourish where all others have failed.
General.Name: Anarch Tenebra

General.Description: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch dfaction. Within the minds of those dedicated to the blade lies a singular focus; to annihilate their enemy in the most effective manner possible.
General.Name: Anarch Gladius

General.Description: A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.
General.Name: Common Avichaea

General.Description: Sabotaged Kuva Distillery
General.Name: Kuva Injector

General.Description: A carrion-eater and opportunistic bird-of-prey. Condrocs gather, feed upon carrion, and occasionally, hunt in groups known as 'committees'. Several committees will be led by an Emperor.
General.Name: Emperor Condroc

General.Description: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.
General.Name: Dusky-Headed Virmink

General.Description: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.
General.Name: Ostia Vasca Kavat

General.Description: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.
General.Name: Ashen Kuaka

General.Description: This large arthropod is generally found flying around Deimos' several grottos.
General.Name: Green Velocipod

General.Description: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.
General.Name: Fuming Dax Stover

General.Name: Sentinel Stover

General.Description: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.
General.Name: Dappled Horrasque

General.Description: The only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
General.Name: Wolf of Saturn Six

General.Description: The origin of these interlopers aboard the Zariman is a mystery to its crew members. Curiously, they are only visible to those who have been touched by the Void.
General.Name: Thrax Legatus

This capricious avian unleashes swarms of infested spores as its primary defense mechanism.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
General.Name: Sporule Avichaea

General.Name: Syzygy Shockwave Moa

General.Description: High damage minigun
General.Name: Heavy Gunner

General.Description:
The Howler is easily startled. Its penetrating scream will cause other, more dangerous animals to investigate.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
General.Name: Howler Undazoa

General.Description: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their lives to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.
General.Name: Woodland Mergoo

General.Description: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.

General.Name: Tomb Guardian

The Crescent is the most pugnacious subspecies of Vulpaphyla, they will rush anything they perceive as a threat.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
General.Name: Crescent Vulpaphyla

General.Description: Often found cocooned on the walls of the Zariman, the Void Angels were once human-like manifestations of people who died in the aftermath of the Zariman disaster. Over time they succumbed to the Void's song, and transformed into these angel-like creatures. They do not like to be disturbed.
General.Name: Void Angel

General.Description: A skittish creature, the Vizier Predasite will unleash a spume of acid before scurrying away.
General.Name: Vizier Predasite

General.Description: An Entrat maintenance drone carring a phial of corrosive solution, to top up laboratory devices
General.Name: Vitriol Necramite

The rarest of Avichaeas, the Viscid produces a thick, tar-like mucus that it discharges when imperiled.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
General.Name: Viscid Avichaea

General.Description: The fastest variety of Velocipod, it tends to favor the swamplands.
General.Name: White Velocipod

General.Description: The Arbiters of Hexis created this drone to put Tenno to the test in Arbitrations.
General.Name: Arbitration Shield Drone

General.Description: The origin of these interlopers aboard the Zariman is a mystery to its crew members. Curiously, they are only visible to those who have been touched by the Void.
General.Name: Thrax Centurion

General.Description: A seasoned combatant that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Engages targets with quick strikes from it's shock baton.
General.Name: Syzygy Prod Crewman

General.Description: The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.
General.Name: Burrowing Cryptilex

General.Description: A diminutive Raknoid that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Occasionally lays explosive mushrooms.
General.Name: Syzygy Mite Raknoid

General.Description: A Bursa unit that has been exposed to the power of the Syzygy. Corrals it's prey for rapid destruction.
General.Name: Syzygy Denial Bursa

General.Description: An attack drone that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys a heat-based aerosol befor pummeling targets from range with energy shells.
General.Name: Syzygy Attack Drone

General.Description: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.
General.Name: Swimmer Horrasque

General.Description: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source of Virmink and Sawgaw.
General.Name: Delicate Pobber

General.Description: A carrion-eater and opportunistic bird-of-prey. Condrocs gather, feed upon carrion, and occasionally, hunt in groups known as 'committees'. Several committees will be led by an Emperor.
General.Name: Rogue Condroc

General.Name: Horrasque Stormer

General.Description: The most common Vulpaphyla, they travel in packs and are generally non-aggressive.
General.Name: Sly Vulpaphyla

General.Name: Subterranean Pobber

General.Description:
Not quite as flighty as its subspecies cousins, it will charge if it feels threatened.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
General.Name: Medjay Predasite

General.Description: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.
General.Name: Spotted Bolarola

General.Description: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their lives to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.
General.Name: Splendid Mergoo

General.Description: 'Soar Gore' as the Solaris call it, this crimson-faced bird of prey circles and stalks the cliffs and fungal forests of Venus, searching for rodent prey.
General.Name: Frogmouthed Sawgaw

General.Description: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source of Virmink and Sawgaw.
General.Name: Sunny Pobber

General.Description: This infectious insect is capable of hazardous viral attacks when alerted.
General.Name: Septic Cryptilex

General.Description: The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts travel in groups and mark the territory surrounding Orokin cooling towers as their own. Kubrodons are a danger best avoided.
General.Name: Kubrodon Incarnadine

General.Description: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.
General.Name: Scuttlers

General.Description: Due to its remarkable strength, this Nexifera can cause seismic shocks when hitting the ground.
General.Name: Scarlet Nexifera

General.Description: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their lives to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.
General.Name: Coastal Mergoo

General.Description: Touched by the hand of Arlo they come to spread his healing word. Rejoice.
General.Name: Devotee

General.Description: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.
General.Name: Thorny Bolarola

General.Description: Awoken by the Protector to help defend the Tomb of Inaros.
General.Name: Tomb Protector Effigy

General.Description: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.
General.Name: Plains Kuaka

General.Description:
This hardy creature has a collagenous dermis that acts as a thick, protective armor.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
General.Name: Panzer Vulpaphyla

General.Description: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar’s Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.
General.Name: Oraxia

General.Description:
Easily frightened, this Predasite flees in the sight of danger, but not before hissing a geyser of parasitic sputum.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
General.Name: Pharaoh Predasite

General.Description: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.
General.Name: Fire-Veined Stover

General.Name: Flossy Sawgaw

General.Name: Kavat

General.Description: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.
General.Name: Nephil Vasca Kavat

General.Name: Brindle Kubrodon

General.Description: The most dangerous Cryptilex. They have glands in their abdomens that can emit an acidic spray.
General.Name: Caustic Cryptilex

General.Description: The Vaporous Undazoa gets its name from the noxious gas it belches out when alerted.
General.Name: Vaporous Undazoa

General.Description: Broken out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen by the Wolf, this fugitive is a loyal member of his pack.
General.Name: Saturn Six Fugitive
